systems.country_label: National Broadband Network Project Phase 1; 'National Backbone'
systems.platform: optical fibre backbone, FTTx access network, IMS/MPLS core; contractor Huawei Technologies
systems.owner: Government of Benin; Benin Telecom S.A., under a China Eximbank concessional loan of RMB 496 million signed 7 April 2015
systems.tiers: National backbone: rehabilitation of the 1,060 km Cotonou-Malanville fibre route, a metropolitan fibre loop in Cotonou and surroundings, 125 access nodes and 30 new 4G base stations; works began December 2016. A later history line carries the decree's plan to extend coverage from 36 to 67 of 77 communes. No commune office is said to be on it.

note: Deal record for the backbone loan (body an excerpt). Communes appear only as places the fibre is to cover; no local government office is said to be connected.
